recipe_version.title: Indonesian Ikan Bakar: Broiled Kecap-Glazed Tilapia with Sambal Tomat
recipe_version.description: Tilapia fillets marinated in kecap manis, lime, garlic, and turmeric and broiled with more glaze until lacquered and charred at the edges, served with a fresh sambal of cherry tomatoes, shallots, Thai chiles, sambal oelek, and lime, plus jasmine rice and cucumber.

ingredients.name: kecap manis
ingredients.display_name: kecap manis (sweet soy sauce) whose label lists sugar, water, soybeans, wheat, and salt

ingredients.name: sambal oelek
ingredients.display_name: sambal oelek whose label lists chile, salt, and vinegar

steps.title: Marinate and prep
steps.body: Stir 2 tbsp kecap manis, 2 tbsp lime juice, the garlic, turmeric, 1/2 tsp salt, and 1 tbsp oil together and coat the fillets. Quarter the tomatoes, slice the shallots, chiles, and cucumber, and rinse the rice until the rinse runs clear.

steps.title: Cook the rice
steps.body: Combine the rice and 2 1/4 cups water in a 2-quart saucepan, bring to a boil over high, about 4 minutes, then cover, turn to low, and cook 15 minutes. Move it off the heat, still covered; it rests through steps 5-6 while the fish marinates on.

steps.title: Make the sambal
steps.body: While the rice cooks (overlap stated): toss the tomatoes, shallots, chiles, sambal oelek, 2 tbsp lime juice, and 1/2 tsp salt in a bowl and leave it to get juicy.

steps.title: Heat the broiler
steps.body: While the rice cooks (overlap stated): preheat the broiler on high with a rack 5 inches below, about 5 minutes. Line the sheet pan with foil and brush it with the remaining oil.

steps.title: Broil
steps.body: Lay the fillets on the pan and brush with half the remaining kecap manis. Broil 4 minutes, brush with the rest, and broil until lacquered, charred at the edges, and 145 F, about 3 minutes more.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Serve the fish with the rice, cucumber slices, and the sambal spooned over or alongside.

Compared with thai-crispy-barramundi-tamarind: lacquered under the broiler, not fried crisp with a tamarind sauce. Compared with grilled-mahi-mahi-mango-salsa: a kecap glaze and chile-tomato sambal, not a mango salsa.
not_duplicate_of: Not teriyaki fish (kecap manis and turmeric, with sambal).
